deadline.value: To be considered for a University Fellowship, all materials are due January 1, 2027; teaching assistant consideration needs January 15 (US) or February 15 (international).
deadline.quote: To be considered for a University Fellowship all application materials must be submitted by January 1

gre_general.value: The GRE is accepted but not required, and scores must be no more than five years old.
gre_general.quote: Note that the GRE test is accepted but not required

supervisor.value: Students find a dissertation advisor in their third year, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: Obtain a dissertation advisor by June of the third year

funding.value: The department lists a 2025-2026 teaching assistant stipend of $35,200 and an 18-credit tuition waiver, but does not say most or all admitted students get one.

entry_route.value: The math pages do not say whether a master's is needed for the PhD.

gre_subject.value: The math page mentions only the general GRE.

notes: Math page says TOEFL is required for non-native speakers but gives no minimum score; the Graduate School minimum applies.
